claude.performance_metric: no goodwill impairment; revenue -5.6% in 2020 then rose to ~$5.21bn in 2021; net income rose to $234.8m
claude.rationale: The slice documents no disruption at the product/process interface: goodwill principally tied to the 2017 combination passed its impairment test with no impairment, revenue recovered to a record ~$5.21bn in 2021, and net income rose across the window, so p4=0. For process/organization, the only integration cost signal is a declining "transaction and integration-related expenses" line ($30m in 2020, down from $61m and $65m) later folded into SG&A—no documented operational-versus-organizational fracture—so p5=0. The unverified note about the former inVentiv CEO's departure from an Executive Chairman role hints at possible archetype (merger-of-equals) asymmetry, but it is explicitly [UNVERIFIED] and not primary-sourced, so t1 is uncertain; the two models operated as one profitable reporting entity with rising results, so t2=0.
